_prefix: the letter of the IDs and the separator: Պ-01, Պ-02 ...; digits: how many digits the number has
_prime: the mark of the type that opens to the other side: Պ-03 and Պ-03'
_order: which type gets which new number: floor (lowest story first, then top to bottom and left to right on the plan), size (largest first), count (most windows first)
_keep_existing: true: types keep the Պ numbers their windows already have, new types get the next ones
_hand_param: the GDL parameter with the opening side (L / R); windows that differ only in it share a number, with a prime
_type_params: GDL parameters that are part of the type, besides library part, width and height (a window part without one of them just leaves it out)
_layers: the tool's own layers: ids = the ID text next to every window on the floor plans, types = the worksheet with the window types and their measurements
_layer_combinations: when the tool makes its layers, Archicad hides them in every layer combination. ids / types: in which combinations to show them then - "all", or words of which one is in the combination's name (the IDs: only on the window marking plans). own: the name of a layer combination made once with the IDs shown (null: none)
